title: Molecular cloning, biophysical and in silico studies of Human papillomavirus 33 E2 DNA binding domain.
one_liner_zh: 该文对HPV33 E2 DNA结合域进行克隆、生物物理表征及同源建模与分子动力学模拟，研究其DNA结合活性与潜在抑制剂，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且含物理模拟方法，可借鉴至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Human papillomavirus 33, a high-risk HPV strain, is mainly responsible for HPV infection and cervical cancer in Asian countries. The E2 protein of HPV 33 is a DNA-binding protein that plays a crucial role in viral replication and transcription. We have cloned, overexpressed, and purified the DNA binding domain of the E2 protein. Size exclusion chromatography results suggested that the protein exists in a homodimeric state in the native form. Circular dichroism data showed that the protein has a higher content of beta-sheet. The melting temperature obtained from differential scanning calorimetry is 52.59  degrees C, and the protein is stable at pH 8 and is in a dimeric form at basic pH. The protein is monomeric or unfolded at a very low pH. Chemical denaturation studies suggested that the protein denatured and dissociated simultaneously. The DNA binding activity of the protein was also confirmed and it showed binding affinity in the order of 10(6) M(-1). The protein structure was modeled using homology modeling and other bioinformatic tools. The virtual screening and molecular dynamic simulation studies were performed to find compounds that can act as potent inhibitors against E2 DBD. This study expands the understanding of the conserved structural and binding properties of HPV33 E2 DBD and provides the first report on the characterization of the viral protein.
abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒33型（HPV33）是一种高危型HPV毒株，主要在亚洲国家导致HPV感染和宫颈癌。HPV33的E2蛋白是一种DNA结合蛋白，在病毒复制和转录中发挥关键作用。我们已克隆、过表达并纯化了E2蛋白的DNA结合域。尺寸排阻色谱结果表明，该蛋白在天然状态下以同源二聚体形式存在。圆二色光谱数据显示，该蛋白具有较高的β-折叠含量。通过差示扫描量热法获得的熔解温度为52.59摄氏度，且该蛋白在pH 8条件下稳定，并在碱性pH下呈二聚体形式。在极低pH下，蛋白呈单体或未折叠状态。化学变性研究表明，该蛋白在变性过程中同时发生解离。该蛋白的DNA结合活性也已得到确认，其结合亲和力数量级为10(6) M(-1)。利用同源建模及其他生物信息学工具对蛋白结构进行了建模。通过虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟研究，寻找可作为E2 DBD有效抑制剂的化合物。本研究扩展了对HPV33 E2 DBD保守结构和结合特性的理解，并首次报道了该病毒蛋白的表征。
